body:
With NX8's 8-bit static formats, the tensor that loses most even in its best format is layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256: 32.1 dB SQNR (signal-to-quantization-noise ratio; higher is better) in fp8_e2m5, measured on that tensor alone by the format search. Measured on 3 models with a format search (of 279 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 16.3 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 7.4 dB (stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae). 2 of 3 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (token agreement 100% → 44%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's) and facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (token agreement 100% → 64%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's).

The tensors that lose most in their best format (their own error): layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 32.1 dB), add output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.0 dB), mul output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.5 dB), linear output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 35.5 dB), div output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 36.9 dB), linear bias in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 37.1 dB), gelu_tanh output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 37.2 dB), silu output in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e3m4, 37.2 dB), conv2d bias in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 37.3 dB) and linear weight in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 37.5 dB).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): mul outputs end furthest from full precision, facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 keeping only -0.8 dB there. The outputs furthest from full precision in each model's best format set: mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, -0.8 dB), conv2d in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 7.4 dB), linear in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 7.6 dB), attention in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 9.2 dB), linear in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 9.2 dB), silu in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 9.4 dB), groupnorm in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 9.6 dB), silu in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 10.5 dB), exp in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 11.0 dB) and attention in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 11.1 dB).

Formats chosen (E = exponent bits, M = mantissa bits, u = unsigned): fp8_e2m5 1322 (53%), fp8_e3m4 820 (33%), fp8_e1m6 351 (14%); 0% of tensors use an unsigned format.

A wider format or a per-row choice would recover most where an output's own error in its format, times its data, is largest: gelu_tanh in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 37.2 dB), gelu_tanh in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 37.2 dB) and gelu_tanh in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 37.4 dB).

1 missing capability keep 29 operations in 1 model (of 2 planned) off the chip's direct path; the most widespread is run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip) (29 operations in 1 model). Ranked by the MACs they hold:

**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip).** The chip cannot read memory at an address computed at run time, so every lookup or choice by a run-time value (embedding) needs a workaround. It affects 29 operations in 1 model: 29 calls (2.32% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: embedding in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256. Cost today: 0 of 29 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 29 wait for one; 0 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, none evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

body:
A kernel reads a tensor in the arrangement its writer stored it in; when the reader needs another arrangement, the reading kernel has to rearrange the data itself. This happens to 229 of 324 tensors passed between kernels (71%) in 2 models: 115 for other reshapes, 111 for attention heads split or merged and 3 for image patches.

The reading operations are 155 operations (155 calls, 12% of all calls; 4.43 G MACs, 3.67% of all MACs). The most common causes (writer → reader): linear → attention (attention heads split or merged) 111, linear → mul (other reshapes) 56 and linear → add (other reshapes) 56; most in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (196) and mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (33).

Cost today: extra cycles not measured yet (no reading kernel has run); 0 links fail.
title: Layout conversions: 229 of 324 tensors between kernels are rearranged

body:
Activations such as exp, GELU and reciprocal go through a 256-entry lookup table (LUT), which limits their precision: 322 operations in 2 models (322 calls, 26% of all calls), most often silu (92), layernorm (78) and attention (37). Their quantized accuracy: worst 9.2 dB SQNR over 322 measured operations.

Kernels per forward pass (host launches, one per planned kernel call): median 35.5, most 58 (facebook/DiT-XL-2-256, 58 planned groups), over 2 models.

FP32 headroom (how far the largest value is from FP32 overflow, in powers of ten) is least at 34.4 powers of ten for mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (largest value 1.48e+04).

Instruction memory (IMEM, 1,024 words per bank) use: not measured yet (no kernel built).
title: Resource limits: 322 operations limited by the LUT and up to 58 kernel launches per pass

body: The only measured cost so far is accuracy: under NX8's 8-bit static formats, model outputs keep a median 21.5 dB SQNR but the worst (mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k) drops to 16.3 dB, with that model's silu output the single worst tensor at 37.2 dB in fp8_e3m4. facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 loses the most prediction quality — token agreement falls from 100% to 59% — and accumulated data-path error leaves its mul outputs at just -3.8 dB versus full precision. The cycles cost is unknown because no kernel has been built yet, so MAC utilisation and IMEM use remain unmeasured. No extra kernels are expected: no operation needs an ISA workaround and no plan passes tensors between kernels, so there are no layout-conversion costs. Resource limits pose no risk, with FP32 headroom at worst 34.4 powers of ten (largest value 1.48e+04, DiT's mul) and no missing capabilities affecting planned models.
